_comment: Editorial fact values migrated from jvto-web src/lib/schemas/entityGraph.ts (2026-08-20). Read by entityGraph.ts's build*() functions and merged over each FALLBACK_* constant there (buildOrganizationJsonLd/buildVerifySchemas.ts proven pattern). JSON-LD scaffolding (@context/@type/@id, cross-reference wiring via {'@id':...}, SHA-256 hash identifiers, recognizedBy entity refs) stays as CODE in entityGraph.ts and externalEntities.ts — only prose/name/description/date values live here. `organizationHasCredential` (NIB/TDUP/HPWKI credential array attached sitewide via src/lib/seo/jsonld/builders.ts attachOrgCredentials()) is deliberately NOT represented here and NOT migrated: that helper is a synchronous function invoked from buildOrganizationJsonLd() across ~15+ pages outside this migration's audited consumer set (destinations, tours hub, why-jvto/reviews, markets, etc.) — forcing it async to read this file would ripple far beyond the entityGraph.ts task scope for a field whose equivalent data already exists in organization-identity/organization.json's own hasCredential array. Left as a follow-up consolidation, not attempted here.

organizationReference._comment: ORGANIZATION_SCHEMA in entityGraph.ts is reference-only — zero live consumers (live's real Organization node is DB-driven via getOrganizationProfile/buildOrganizationJsonLd). Migrated for parity anyway since it's an explicit entityGraph.ts export. slogan/award already match organization-identity/organization.json verbatim; description is new (not present in organization.json).

bbksdaRegulation.name: Ijen Crater Access — Health Certificate Requirement
bbksdaRegulation.description: Under SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024 issued by BBKSDA Jawa Timur, visitors to Kawah Ijen must present a health certificate from a licensed clinic confirming blood pressure and oxygen saturation readings are within safe limits.
bbksdaRegulation.serviceOutputName: Health Certificate for Ijen Crater Access (Surat Keterangan Sehat)

NIB.name: NIB (Nomor Induk Berusaha)
NIB.description: Indonesian Business Identification Number. Mandatory registration for all legal businesses in Indonesia, issued via the OSS Online Single Submission system. JVTO NIB: 1102230032918.

TDUP.name: TDUP (Tanda Daftar Usaha Pariwisata)
TDUP.description: Tourism Business Registration Certificate. The mandatory operating licence for tour operators in Indonesia, issued by the Kementerian Pariwisata dan Ekonomi Kreatif via OSS. JVTO TDUP issued 2023-02-11.

HPWKI.name: HPWKI (Himpunan Pelaku Wisata Khusus Ijen)
HPWKI.description: Ijen Volcano Tourism Association. Supervised by BBKSDA Jawa Timur (Ministry of Environment). HPWKI members receive annual training on volcanic gas protocols, emergency evacuation, and BBKSDA compliance. Membership is required to operate guided tours on Kawah Ijen.

KTA.name: KTA (Kartu Tanda Anggota)
KTA.description: HPWKI Guide Licence Card. Issued to verified Ijen volcano guides who have completed BBKSDA-supervised safety training. Required for any guide accompanying tourists to Kawah Ijen. Each card carries a unique identifier number.

POLPAR.name: POLPAR (Polisi Pariwisata / Tourist Police)
POLPAR.description: Indonesian Tourist Police unit under Polisi Pariwisata (POLPAR), Polres Bondowoso, Indonesian National Police (POLRI). POLPAR officers are assigned to secure and support tourism areas. Assignment requires a SPRIN (Surat Perintah / Official Order Letter) from POLRI.

BBKSDA.name: BBKSDA (Balai Besar Konservasi Sumber Daya Alam)
BBKSDA.description: Large-Scale Natural Resource Conservation Agency under the Indonesian Ministry of Environment and Forestry. BBKSDA Jawa Timur manages Kawah Ijen nature reserve and issues access regulations including SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024 (health certificate requirement).

SE1658.name: SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024
SE1658.description: BBKSDA Jawa Timur circular letter SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024. Requires all Kawah Ijen visitors to present a health certificate from a licensed clinic confirming blood pressure and SpO₂ readings are within safe limits before entering the crater area.

ISIC.name: ISIC (International Student Identity Card)
ISIC.description: Global student membership card accepted at 150,000+ discounts in 130+ countries. JVTO is a verified ISIC partner (Provider ID 259268) — Ijen and Bromo tour packages are available at student rates to valid ISIC cardholders. Verifiable at isic.org/discounts/?providerId=259268.

INDECON.name: INDECON (Indonesian Ecotourism Network)
INDECON.description: Indonesian Ecotourism Network — national advocacy body for responsible tourism and nature conservation. JVTO holds Spotlight Network membership, recognized for responsible volcanic tourism practices at Kawah Ijen and Mount Bromo. Verifiable at indecon.id/spotlight-networks/java-volcano-tour-operator.

JVTO_TRAVEL_CREDIT.name: Lifetime Package Credit
JVTO_TRAVEL_CREDIT.description: JVTO operational policy: for a full guest-initiated cancellation at least 48 hours before Day 1, 100% of the amount paid converts to Lifetime Package Credit — never cash. Non-expiring; locked to the same package, traveler count and price; cannot be split or changed to another package; transferable to another person once, with written authorisation. Differentiator vs industry-standard expiring vouchers. Force-majeure closures fall under the same policy.

JVTO_FOC_SCHEME.name: JVTO FOC Scheme
JVTO_FOC_SCHEME.description: JVTO Free-of-Charge group-discount scheme: 18 paying pax → 1 free, 35 paying pax → 2 free, 50 paying pax → 3 free. Applies on a single booking across the same trip dates. Transparent published thresholds (no negotiation), automated at checkout. Designed for student trips, corporate retreats, and family-cluster bookings.

javaIslandPlace.description: Java is an island in Indonesia — the world's most populous island, home to Jakarta, Surabaya, Mount Bromo, and Kawah Ijen. Distinct from Java the programming language.
